QuestInfo.name: Gift
QuestInfo.0: Your 3rd Job Advancement is complete! #b#p2300000##k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2300000# recommended you buy gifts for your friends in Edelstein. AND you're not allowed to ask the recipient what they want! 
Consult the following people of #m230050000# on which gifts to get for each recipient.\r\n

Professor Dreamboat - Elex\r\n
Promathus - Brighton\r\n
Nathania- Belle\r\n
Edwin - Checky\r\n
Yourself - Claudine
QuestInfo.2:
You gave out all your gifts, but nobody seemed too excited. Talk to #p2300000#.

#b(Next quest requirement: Lv. 70.)

0.0: #h0#! You're advancing! Everybody's going to think you're super cool now!\r\n#L0##bThanks. Do I need to act differently now?#l\n#k
0.1: I dunno. Why don't you go show off to all your friends in Edelstein?\r\n#L0##bI have missed them...#l\n#k
0.2: You're just going to go over there empty-handed?\r\n#L0##bIs that bad?#l\n#k
0.3: Shouldn't you at least bring them some souvenirs from your trips? That's simple human etiquette!\r\n#L0##bIt is? What kind of souvenirs?#l\n#k
0.4: Um, I dunno! Maybe you should ask #bsomeone who's similar to the person#k you're getting a gift for. \r\n#L0##bWhy don't I just ask the gift recipient instead?#l\n#k
0.5: Well, humans don't like that for some reason.\r\n#L0##bThat's difficult, but I trust you.#l\n#k
0.6: Good! Even though I don't really know about this kinda stuff either... Maybe you should ask #bProfessor Dreamboat#k!

yes.0: I'm sure #bProfessor Dreamboat#k knows lots about gifts... he's so handsome!

no.0: You don't want to? I thought my idea was pretty solid.

1.0: Hey there #h0#. How did the gifting go?\r\n#L0##bIt's been enlightening... (You tell her what happened.)#l\n#k
1.1: Whew. I thought I didn't understand humans, but you're terrible!\r\n#L0##bI am?#l\n#k
1.2: I'm sure you'll figure it out one day... Human relationships are tough to maintain, but important. Kinda like my hip fluctuators!
